page.content:
Peer-review group that notes unfinished films.

How Pixar Braintrust connects

  • Topic: Pixar — The Braintrust is Pixar's internal story-review circle.
  • Character: Ed Catmull — Catmull described and protected the Braintrust as a studio practice.
  • Creator: John Lasseter — Lasseter was a central voice in the early Braintrust.
  • Creator: Pete Docter — Docter is a long-running Braintrust director.

What is Pixar Braintrust?

The Pixar Braintrust is the circle of directors and story leads Catmull described: a room that can say a reel does not work before the studio ships it.

Key threads lead to Pixar, Ed Catmull, John Lasseter and Pete Docter.
